load_gemma3n_tokenizer: load a Gemma3n tokenizer from a HuggingFace tokenizer.json directory path
create_encoder: create a token encoder with BOS prefix for Gemma3n in default or prompt mode
create_decoder: create a token decoder to decode Gemma3n token IDs back to text
apply_chat_template: apply the Gemma3n chat template to a conversation list and return tokenized output
create_raw_encoder: create a raw token encoder without BOS or EOS special tokens for Gemma3n
